newsitem.title: KUWAIT: U.S. defence official arrives in Kuwait in tour.
newsitem.headline: U.S. defence official arrives in Kuwait in tour.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Defence Secretary John White arrived in Kuwait on Tuesday for a two-day visit to the Gulf Arab state as part a tour of allied countries in the region.
White, who has also visited Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain, is expected to visit U.S. and other military installations in Kuwait later on Tuesday.

A U.S. embassy spokeswoman said White will not discuss the deployment of eight radar-evading F-117A Stealth warplanes which were sent to Kuwait in September during the latest standoff between between Washington and Iraq.
Washington said last month the aircraft would soon leave but military sources believe they are still in Kuwait.
The United States has a military presence in Kuwait ever since a U.S.-led military coalition freed Kuwait from a seven-month Iraqi occupation in 1991.
Some 1,200 U.S. troops were deployed in Kuwait in recent weeks for routine joint exercises.
